datasets.title: Malawi - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Malawi with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/malawi-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded population data (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta), assigning representative points to each cluster, and generating Voronoi-based catchment areas. Population was disaggregated by sex and age from multiple sources, and building counts were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google building detection datasets with confidence filtering, then aggregated to settlement catchment boundaries.

sources.description: Alternative population distribution dataset (2023) integrated for population estimation

sources.name: Meta

sources.description: Building footprint inventory (2024) contributing to building stock counts

sources.description: Machine-learning detected building footprints (2023) with confidence filtering used to supplement building counts
